name: Daily Revenue
description: Order count and revenue per day within a date range, for a given order status.
sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', o.created_at)::date AS day, count(*) AS order_count, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM ecommerce.orders o JOIN ecommerce.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.created_at >= :from AND o.created_at < :to AND o.status = :status GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: Top Products by Revenue
description: Highest-grossing products, limited to the top N.
sql: SELECT p.sku, p.name, sum(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, sum(oi.total_price) AS revenue FROM ecommerce.order_items oi JOIN ecommerce.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.sku, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT :limit
